question.text: A particle moves along the $x$-axis and has its displacement $x$ varying with time $t$ according to the equation $\mathrm{x}=\mathrm{c}_0\left(\mathrm{t}^2-2\right)+\mathrm{c}(\mathrm{t}-2)^2$ where $c_0$ and $c$ are constants of appropriate dimensions. Then, which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: the acceleration of the particle is $2 \mathrm{c}_0$
the acceleration of the particle is $2\mathrm{~c}$
the initial velocity of the particle is $4\mathrm{~c}$
the acceleration of the particle is $2\left(c+c_0\right)$
